通用技术和投机性泡沫检测General-Purpose Technology and Speculative Bubble Detection

摘要Abstract

我们表明，当基本原理与通用技术采用相结合时，领先的气泡测试会遭受严重的尺寸扭曲。在坎贝尔-希勒现值模型中嵌入驼峰形技术冲击，我们证明基本价格在采用过程中会局部爆炸，从而用与冲击峰值成比例的非中心参数污染了测试的极限分布。我们提出了一种基本面与投机性的分解，将价格投射到可观察的技术代理上，并将测试应用于残差。从经验上看，这种分解消除了 2020 年至 2025 年人工智能反弹的投机证据，同时确认了互联网泡沫时期的投机峰值仅限于 1999 年 12 月至 2000 年 3 月。We show that the leading bubble test suffers severe size distortion when fundamentals incorporate general-purpose technology adoption. Embedding a hump-shaped technology shock in the Campbell-Shiller present-value model, we prove that the fundamental price becomes locally explosive during adoption, contaminating the test’s limit distribution with a non-centrality parameter proportional to the shock’s peak. We propose a fundamental-versus-speculative decomposition that projects prices onto observable technology proxies and applies the test to the residual. Empirically, the decomposition eliminates evidence of speculation in the 2020–2025 AI rally while confirming a speculative peak confined to December 1999–March 2000 in the dot-com episode.

关键词Keywords：通用技术、投机泡沫、泡沫检测、人工智能、现值模型: general-purpose technology, speculative bubbles, bubble detection, artificial intelligence, present-value model

JEL分类JEL classification：C12、C22、G12、O33: C12, C22, G12, O33

1 简介Introduction

自 2022 年底发布大型语言模型以来，股市经历了大幅上涨，主要集中在人工智能 (AI) 相关公司。 “七大巨头”（Alphabet、亚马逊、苹果、Meta、微软、NVIDIA 和特斯拉）贡献了 2023 年至 2024 年标准普尔 500 指数涨幅的大部分Since the release of large language models in late 2022, equity markets have experienced a dramatic rally concentrated in artificial-intelligence (AI)-related firms. The “Magnificent Seven” (Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Tesla) accounted for a majority of the S&P 500’s gains during 2023–2024(Basele et al., 2025)，纳斯达克综合指数较 2022 年 10 月的低谷几乎翻了一番。企业人工智能投资同步激增，总计算支出、相关专利和研发 (R&D) 强度均快速上升, and the NASDAQ Composite nearly doubled from its October 2022 trough. Corporate AI investment has surged in parallel, with aggregate compute expenditure, related patenting, and research and development (R&D) intensity all rising rapidly(McElheran et al., 2024; Pairolero et al., 2025; Aldasoro et al., 2026)，而生成式人工智能对生产力的影响开始在公司层面的数据中体现, while productivity effects of generative AI are beginning to materialize in firm-level data(Brynjolfsson et al., 2025)。在快速但不确定的技术变革中，科技股集中上涨的模式与 20 世纪 90 年代末纳斯达克的上涨相呼应，随后纳斯达克的崩盘摧毁了数万亿美元的市值。研究人员、监管机构和投资者现在和过去面临的核心问题是一样的：这些价格动态是投机泡沫，还是经济生产能力的理性重新定价？. The pattern of a concentrated technology rally amid rapid but uncertain technological change echoes the late-1990s NASDAQ run-up, whose subsequent crash destroyed trillions of dollars in market value. The central question for researchers, regulators, and investors is the same now as it was then: are these price dynamics a speculative bubble, or a rational repricing of the economy’s productive capacity?

本文提出了一个每次技术革命都会重复出现的问题：标准泡沫测试是否系统性地将基本面重新定价误认为是投机过度？最广泛使用的实时气泡检测器是开创性的右尾单位根检验This paper asks a question that recurs with every technological revolution: are standard bubble tests systematically mistaking fundamental repricing for speculative excess? The most widely used real-time bubble detector is the seminal right-tailed unit root test ofPhillips et al. (2015a, b)（以下简称 PSY），现已嵌入全球中央银行的监控框架中。(hereafter PSY), now embedded in the surveillance frameworks of central banks worldwide.111例如，参见达拉斯联邦储备银行国际房价数据库，该数据库通常应用 PSY 程序See, for example, the Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas International House Price Database, which routinely applies the PSY procedure(Pavlidis et al., 2016).应用于当前的反弹，PSY 检测到爆炸性的动态。然而，它的零假设是纯粹的随机游走，并且完全从基本面的结构变化中抽象出来。正是在通用技术（GPT）采用期间，当泡沫问题最为紧迫时，技术驱动的基本面本身会产生局部爆炸性的价格动态，从观察上看，这些价格动态与投机没有什么区别。这种风险不仅仅是统计假象：如果政策制定者将技术重新定价视为泡沫，过早干预可能会扼杀推动长期增长的采用过程。Applied to the current rally, PSY detects explosive dynamics. Yet its null hypothesis is a pure random walk and abstracts entirely from structural change in fundamentals. Precisely during periods of general-purpose technology (GPT) adoption, when the bubble question is most pressing, technology-driven fundamentals themselves generate locally explosive price dynamics that are observationally indistinguishable from speculation. The risk is not merely a statistical artifact: if policymakers treat a technological repricing as a bubble, premature intervention can stifle the very adoption process that drives long-run growth.

我们的第一个贡献是关于人工智能反弹和 20 世纪 90 年代末互联网泡沫事件的新经验证据。我们表明，一旦考虑到技术基本面，2020-2025 年人工智能反弹在任何传统显着水平上都不会留下投机行为的证据。对于互联网泡沫时期，分解消除了早期的虚假信号，但证实了从 1999 年 12 月到 2000 年 3 月的真正投机高峰：技术驱动的上涨是根本性的，只有最后阶段是投机的。这些发现证实了关于技术革命期间资产价格上涨是否反映理性重新定价或非理性繁荣的长期争论Our first contribution is new empirical evidence on the AI rally and the late-1990s dot-com episode. We show that the 2020–2025 AI rally leaves no evidence of speculative behavior at any conventional significance level once technology fundamentals are accounted for. For the dot-com episode, the decomposition eliminates an early spurious signal but confirms a genuine speculative peak from December 1999 to March 2000: the technology-driven run-up was fundamental, and only the terminal phase was speculative. These findings speak to the long-standing debate over whether asset price booms during technological revolutions reflect rational repricing or irrational exuberance(Pástor and Veronesi, 2009, 2006)，并提供了第一个正式证据，证明这两个事件通常被视为类似，但在经济上是不同的。, and provide the first formal evidence that the two episodes, often treated as analogous, are economically distinct.

我们的第二个贡献是方法论上的。我们记录的规模扭曲是更广泛的识别问题的一个具体实例：基本面的确定性结构变化可以导致 PSY 测试拒绝无泡沫的无效性，即使不存在投机成分。现有的工作已经检查了错误指定的相关来源，包括随时间变化的贴现率Our second contribution is methodological. The size distortion we document is a specific instance of a broader identification problem: deterministic structural change in fundamentals can lead the PSY test to reject the null of no bubble even when no speculative component is present. Existing work has examined related sources of misspecification, including time-varying discount rates(Cochrane, 2011), 理性泡沫动力学, rational bubble dynamics(Blanchard and Watson, 1982; Diba and Grossman, 1988; Evans, 1991)，以及单位根推理中的结构断裂, and structural breaks in unit root inference(Phillips et al., 2011, 2015b; Harvey et al., 2015, 2016; Monschang and Wilfling, 2021)。技术渠道是独特的：GPT 的驼峰形、非线性采用概况产生了标准线性去趋势无法消除的局部爆炸性动态。从形式上讲，一旦基本面纳入了技术驱动的结构性变化，不存在泡沫并不能保证不存在爆炸性动态。. The technology channel is distinctive: the hump-shaped, nonlinear adoption profile of GPTs produces locally explosive dynamics that standard linear detrending cannot remove. Formally, the absence of a bubble does not guarantee the absence of explosive dynamics once fundamentals incorporate technology-driven structural change.

我们的第三个贡献是基本面与投机的分解，在应用 PSY 之前删除估计的技术组件，恢复正确的大小，同时保留对抗真正泡沫的能力。分解使用了三个可观察的技术指标——全要素生产率（TFP）、信息技术（IT）投资和专利授权——每一个指标都基于生产方的微观基础，并且都与价格的投机成分分开。随机技术扩展嵌套了一个简化版本Our third contribution is a fundamental-versus-speculative decomposition that removes the estimated technology component before applying PSY, restoring correct size while preserving power against genuine bubbles. The decomposition uses three observable technology proxies—total factor productivity (TFP), information technology (IT) investment, and patent grants—each grounded in a production-side microfoundation and each separable from the speculative component of prices. A stochastic technology extension nests a simplified version of thePástor and Veronesi (2009)不确定性解决框架，并表明确定性结果是真实尺寸失真的保守下限。uncertainty-resolution framework and shows that the deterministic results are a conservative lower bound on the true size distortion.

该分析嵌入在The analysis is embedded in theCampbell and Shiller (1988)对数线性现值框架。 GPT 冲击，定义为股息增长中的驼峰形、确定性组成部分，反映了技术采用和成熟度log-linear present-value framework. A GPT shock, defined as a hump-shaped, deterministic component in dividend growth that reflects technology adoption and maturation(Bresnahan and Trajtenberg, 1995; Jovanovic and Rousseau, 2005)，在基本价格中生成技术现值项。在采用阶段，随着未来技术驱动的股息增长的市场价格上涨，这一术语急剧上升，在完全基本的价格股息比率中产生局部爆炸性动态。根据经验，我们通过泡沫前训练期间可观察技术代理价格的协整回归来估计技术成分，遵循反事实方法, generates a technology present-value term in the fundamental price. During the adoption phase, this term rises sharply as the market prices in future technology-driven dividend growth, producing locally explosive dynamics in the price-dividend ratio that are entirely fundamental. Empirically, we estimate the technology component via a cointegrating regression of prices on observable technology proxies during a pre-bubble training period, following the counterfactual approach ofHsiao et al. (2012)，并将 PSY 应用于残差，在无气泡的情况下，残差是平稳的。, and apply PSY to the residual, which under the null of no bubble is stationary.

畸变的数量级很大。在根据战后美国股市数据进行校准且仅包含技术驱动的基本面且不含投机成分的蒙特卡罗模拟中，PSY 在 93% 的去趋势原木价格样本中拒绝了无泡沫的假设，在 5% 名义水平的价格股息率样本中拒绝了 100% 的无泡沫假设。移除技术组件可将废品率恢复至标称水平。在真正的泡沫与技术冲击共存的受控重叠实验中，未经调整的测试在纯技术阶段过早启动，而技术调整的程序正确地延迟了检测，直到真正的投机活动开始。对于纳斯达克网络泡沫，未经调整的测试检测到两个爆炸性事件：1996 年 5 月的短暂信号和 1999 年 11 月至 2000 年 3 月的主要事件。我们的分解消除了早期信号，并将真正的投机峰值缩小到 1999 年 12 月到 2000 年 3 月。对于 2020-2025 年人工智能反弹，技术调整完全消除了爆炸性信号：以技术调整为条件框架中，没有任何传统显着性水平上的推测证据。对七巨头的企业层面分析证实了这一模式：微软、Alphabet、NVIDIA的爆炸性信号在技术调整后消失。The quantitative magnitude of the distortion is large. In Monte Carlo simulations calibrated to postwar United States equity data and containing only technology-driven fundamentals with no speculative component, PSY rejects the null of no bubble in 93 percent of samples for detrended log prices and 100 percent for the price-dividend ratio at the 5 percent nominal level. Removing the technology component restores the rejection rate to its nominal level. In a controlled overlap experiment in which a genuine bubble coexists with a technology shock, the unadjusted test fires prematurely during the technology-only phase, while the technology-adjusted procedure correctly delays detection until genuine speculative activity begins. For the NASDAQ dot-com episode, the unadjusted test detects two explosive episodes: a brief signal in May 1996 and the main episode from November 1999 to March 2000. Our decomposition eliminates the early signal and narrows the genuine speculative peak to December 1999 through March 2000. For the 2020–2025 AI rally, the technology adjustment eliminates the explosive signal entirely: conditional on the technology-adjusted framework, there is no evidence of speculation at any conventional significance level. Firm-level analysis of the Magnificent Seven confirms this pattern: explosive signals in Microsoft, Alphabet, and NVIDIA disappear after technology adjustment.

结果在技术冲击的四种函数形式（三角形、高斯、Beta 和类 Gamma 分布）中都是稳健的；跨越动态普通最小二乘法 (DOLS)、完全修改的普通最小二乘法 (FMOLS) 和协整回归的一阶差分规范；以及人工智能时代的 121 个替代培训窗口。一系列识别诊断——格兰杰因果检验、非技术协变量的安慰剂检验、公司层面价格差距的主成分分析（PCA）以及培训窗口稳定性分析——支持技术代理与投机成分的可分离性。The results are robust across four functional forms for the technology shock (triangular, Gaussian, Beta, and Gamma-like profiles); across dynamic ordinary least squares (DOLS), fully modified ordinary least squares (FMOLS), and first-difference specifications of the cointegrating regression; and across 121 alternative training windows for the AI era. A battery of identification diagnostics—Granger causality tests, placebo tests with non-technology covariates, principal component analysis (PCA) of firm-level price gaps, and training-window stability analysis—supports the separability of the technology proxies from the speculative component.

部分Section2开发了理论框架，将技术增强的股息增长嵌入现值模型中，并为可观察的技术代理提供了生产方微观基础。部分develops the theoretical framework, embedding technology-augmented dividend growth in the present-value model and providing a production-side microfoundation for the observable technology proxies. Section3得出形式尺寸变形结果。部分derives the formal size distortion result. Section4定义基本面与投机性分解并确定其规模和功效属性。部分defines the fundamental-versus-speculative decomposition and establishes its size and power properties. Section5将这种方法应用于互联网和人工智能时代的事件，并为七巨头提供了公司层面的证据。部分applies the methodology to the dot-com and AI-era episodes and presents firm-level evidence for the Magnificent Seven. Section6最后对技术转型期间的实时泡沫监控产生了影响。concludes with implications for real-time bubble surveillance during technological transitions.

2 理论框架Theoretical Framework

2.2 技术增强股息增长Technology-Augmented Dividend Growth

本小节介绍了推动我们主要业绩的股息增长的结构模型。关键的创新是瞬态的驼峰形技术组件This subsection introduces the structural model of dividend growth that drives our main results. The key innovation is a transient, hump-shaped technology componentδt\delta_{t}叠加在其他标准随机趋势上。从经济上来说，superimposed on an otherwise standard stochastic trend. Economically,δt\delta_{t}代表了通用技术（蒸汽机、电气化或人工智能）的短暂贡献，这些技术暂时提高了总体生产力，同时采用在整个经济中扩散，然后随着新技术被完全吸收而逐渐消失。正式地，represents the transient contribution of a general-purpose technology—the steam engine, electrification, or artificial intelligence—that temporarily lifts aggregate productivity while adoption diffuses through the economy and then fades as the new technology is fully absorbed. Formally,δt\delta_{t}是确定性的和有界的，它保留了股息过程与其平均增长率的协整，同时允许在采用窗口内丰富的非平稳动态。假设is deterministic and bounded, which preserves cointegration of the dividend process with its mean growth rate while allowing rich non-stationary dynamics over the adoption window. The next proposition records this heuristic formally: along the adoption–maturation cycle, the fundamental price passes through four qualitatively distinct regimes—a near-random-walk regime before adoption, a super-normal-growth regime early in adoption, a deceleration regime late in adoption, and a new-level random-walk regime after maturation. The key statistical implication is that the price-dividend ratio is strictly convex on an initial subinterval of the adoption window, which is precisely the property that drives the spurious-explosiveness result of Theorem1.

3.2 尺寸扭曲问题The Size Distortion Problem

PSY 检验的原假设是纯随机游走。然而，在我们技术增强的数据生成过程中，即使没有泡沫，可观测值也不会遵循随机游走。我们考虑两种常见的经验实现。The null hypothesis of the PSY test is a pure random walk. Under our technology-augmented data-generating process, however, the observables do not follow a random walk even in the absence of a bubble. We consider two common empirical implementations.

实施 1：去趋势原木价格。Implementation 1: Detrended log prices.

形式化证明在附录中给出The formal proof is given in AppendixD。关键机制是，技术冲击在零值下的过程中引入了局部确定性趋势成分，导致去趋势的对数价格和对数价格股息率出现虚假拒绝。正式的渐近处理是在定理中发展的. The key mechanism is that the technology shock introduces a locally deterministic trending component into the process under the null, causing spurious rejections for both detrended log prices and the log price-dividend ratio. The formal asymptotic treatment is developed in Theorem2和提案and Proposition5下面。below.

4 基本分解过程与推测分解过程A Fundamental-versus-Speculative Decomposition Procedure

4.1 调整程序The Adjustment Procedure

附录中记录的尺寸变形The size distortion documented in AppendixE之所以出现这种情况，是因为标准 PSY 测试没有考虑到基本面中技术驱动的部分。我们的补救措施是在应用 PSY 之前估计该组件并将其删除。arises because the standard PSY test does not account for the technology-driven component of fundamentals. Our remedy is to estimate this component and remove it before applying PSY.

如果技术驱动的股息增长的时间序列递增If a time series of technology-driven dividend growth incrementsδ^t\hat{\delta}_{t}可用（例如，从专利流、研发支出增长或生产力衡量标准），人们可以构建is available (e.g., from patent flows, research and development expenditure growth, or productivity measures), one can construct

方法 2：半参数提取。Approach 2: Semiparametric extraction.

人们可以非参数地估计价格股息率的确定性部分，例如通过拟合时间的平滑函数：One can estimate the deterministic component of the price-dividend ratio nonparametrically, e.g., by fitting a smooth function of time:

方法 3：基于制度的估计。Approach 3: Regime-based estimation.

在 PSY 确定的非泡沫时期（“训练期”），通过协整回归估计价格、股息和技术代理之间的长期关系。使用估计模型构建标记为泡沫期间的技术组件。During periods identified as non-bubble by PSY (“training periods”), estimate the long-run relationship between prices, dividends, and technology proxies via a cointegrating regression. Use the estimated model to construct the technology component during the periods flagged as bubbles.

5 实证应用Empirical Applications

前面几节从理论上并通过模拟证明，技术驱动的基本面可以产生局部爆炸性的价格动态，从观察上看，这些价格动态与投机泡沫没有什么区别。现在，我们将基本面与投机性分解以及标准 PSY 测试应用于数字时代的两个阶段：20 世纪 90 年代末纳斯达克互联网泡沫的崛起和 2020 年代人工智能驱动的反弹。The preceding sections establish theoretically and via simulation that technology-driven fundamentals can generate locally explosive price dynamics that are observationally indistinguishable from speculative bubbles. We now apply the fundamental-versus-speculative decomposition alongside the standard PSY test to two episodes that bookend the digital age: the late-1990s NASDAQ dot-com run-up and the AI-driven rally of the 2020s.

5.1 识别挑战The Identification Challenge

实证泡沫检测的一个根本障碍是计量经济学家只观察市场价格A fundamental obstacle in empirical bubble detection is that the econometrician observes only the market priceptp_{t}, 基本价值之和, the sum of the fundamental valueftf_{t}和任何气泡成分and any bubble componentbtb_{t}:

pt=ft+bt.p_{t}=f_{t}+b_{t}.

在潜在的泡沫时期，During a potential bubble period,ftf_{t}不可直接观察：它不能从价格中“读出”，因为价格本身可能受到泡沫的污染。结果就是一个循环——检验泡沫需要了解基本面，而了解基本面则需要知道是否存在泡沫。is not directly observable: it cannot be “read off” from prices, because prices themselves are potentially contaminated by the bubble. The result is a circularity—testing for a bubble requires knowing the fundamental, but knowing the fundamental requires knowing whether there is a bubble.

我们的理论框架（部分Our theoretical framework (Section2）表明基本价格是股息、技术驱动的增长和贴现率的函数：) shows that the fundamental price is a function of dividends, technology-driven growth, and discount rates:

ft=dt+C+𝒯t,f_{t}=d_{t}+C+\mathcal{T}_{t},

哪里where𝒯t=∑j=0∞ρj​δt+1+j\mathcal{T}_{t}=\sum_{j=0}^{\infty}\rho^{j}\delta_{t+1+j}汇总了技术驱动的股息增长的未来路径。原则上，如果我们能够观察技术成分aggregates the future path of technology-driven dividend growth. In principle, if we could observe the technology componentδt\delta_{t}和折扣系数and the discount factorρ\rho，我们可以构建, we could construct𝒯t\mathcal{T}_{t}直接。在实践中，技术路径是不确定的，代理人的信息集比计量经济学家的信息集更丰富，并且从可观察的技术指标到技术指标的映射directly. In practice, the technology path is uncertain, agents’ information sets are richer than the econometrician’s, and the mapping from observable technology indicators toδt\delta_{t}是不精确的。is imprecise.

我们通过采用反事实估计方法来应对这一挑战We address this challenge by adapting the counterfactual estimation approach ofHsiao et al. (2012)。关键的见解是，在. The key insight is that during非泡沫时期non-bubble periods，观察到的价格等于基本面（直到平稳噪声），因此可以使用这些周期来估计基本面和可观察协变量之间的关系。在潜在泡沫时期，估计关系用于构建反事实基本面，并将 PSY 应用于残差。, the observed price equals the fundamental (up to stationary noise), so one can use these periods to estimate the relationship between the fundamental and observable covariates. During the potential bubble period, the estimated relationship is used to construct a counterfactual fundamental, and PSY is applied to the residual.

5.4 数据Data

样本涵盖 1975 年 1 月至 2005 年 12 月，按月进行。我们将训练期定义为1975年1月至1990年12月（The sample covers January 1975 to December 2005, at monthly frequency. We define the training period as January 1975 to December 1990 (T0=192T_{0}=192月），评估期为1991年1月至2005年12月（months) and the evaluation period as January 1991 to December 2005 (T1=180T_{1}=180月）。培训期提供了一个重要的估计窗口，该窗口早于人们普遍接受的互联网泡沫开始之前。评估期包括纳斯达克的上涨期（1995年至2000年）、崩盘期（2000年至2002年）以及随后的复苏期（2003年至2005年）。months). The training period provides a substantial estimation window that predates the commonly accepted start of the dot-com bubble. The evaluation period encompasses the NASDAQ run-up (1995–2000), the crash (2000–2002), and the subsequent recovery (2003–2005).

对于仅按季度频率提供的变量（研发支出、收益、账面价值、TFP），我们使用三次样条插值法将其插值到每月频率，这保留了低频动态，同时允许与每月股价数据保持一致。表For variables available only at quarterly frequency (R&D expenditure, earnings, book value, TFP), we interpolate to monthly frequency using cubic spline interpolation, which preserves the low-frequency dynamics while allowing alignment with the monthly stock price data. First, the May 1996 episode detected by the standard test完全消失disappears entirely技术调整后，将短暂的爆炸性信号归因于技术驱动的基本面成分，而不是投机——仅靠标准测试无法分离出的信息。其次，主要泡沫事件的开始时间从 1999 年 11 月（标准）转移到 1999 年 12 月（调整后），这表明技术成分略微加速了爆炸行为的明显开始。总而言之，技术调整将检测到的事件数量从两次减少到一次，并缩小了真正投机高峰的时间，这与基本技术动态在原材料价格中产生爆炸性信号的预测一致。after technology adjustment, attributing the brief explosive signal to the technology-driven fundamental component rather than speculation—information the standard test alone cannot isolate. Second, the onset of the main bubble episode shifts from November 1999 (standard) to December 1999 (adjusted), indicating that the technology component slightly accelerates the apparent onset of explosive behavior. Taken together, the technology adjustment reduces the number of detected episodes from two to one and narrows the timing of the genuine speculative peak, consistent with the prediction that fundamental technology dynamics generate explosive signals in raw prices.

5.6 人工智能时代的拉力赛The Artificial-Intelligence Era Rally

我们现在转向最紧迫的当代应用：2020 年代人工智能驱动的股市上涨。 2022 年底大型语言模型的发布引发了技术相关股票价格的持续飙升，引发了我们的框架所解决的相同基本问题：观察到的价格动态是否反映了对 GPT 冲击或投机过度的理性基本反应。We now turn to the most pressing contemporary application: the AI-driven equity rally of the 2020s. The release of large language models in late 2022 triggered a sustained surge in technology-related equity prices, raising the same fundamental question our framework addresses: whether the observed price dynamics reflect a rational fundamental response to a GPT shock or speculative excess.

5.6.1  动机和背景5.6.1  Motivation and Background

人工智能的上涨与互联网泡沫的发展有结构上的相似之处。两者都具有 GPT，其生产力影响事前不确定The AI rally shares structural parallels with the dot-com episode. Both feature a GPT whose productivity implications are uncertain ex ante(Acemoglu, 2025; Brynjolfsson et al., 2025)，价格上涨集中在科技公司，科技投资迅速扩张。 2022 年 10 月至 2025 年初，纳斯达克综合指数几乎翻了一番，其中“七巨头”股票（Alphabet、亚马逊、苹果、Meta、微软、英伟达和特斯拉）在市值收益中占据了不成比例的份额, a concentration of price gains in technology firms, and a rapid expansion of technology investment. Between October 2022 and early 2025, the NASDAQ Composite nearly doubled, with the “Magnificent Seven” stocks (Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Tesla) accounting for a disproportionate share of market-capitalization gains(Basele et al., 2025)。企业在人工智能计算基础设施上的资本支出激增，人工智能相关专利申请加速. Corporate capital expenditure on AI compute infrastructure has surged, AI-related patent filings have accelerated(Pairolero et al., 2025; McElheran et al., 2024)，人工智能投资的融资方式从内部现金流转向外债, and the financing of AI investment has shifted from internal cash flows toward external debt(Aldasoro et al., 2026).

Basele et al. (2025)在此期间将标准 PSY 程序应用于七巨头和纳斯达克综合指数，并找到爆炸行为的证据。我们的理论和模拟结果表明，这些发现可以反映人工智能技术冲击引起的基本面重新定价；各节中开发的框架apply the standard PSY procedure to the Magnificent Seven and the NASDAQ Composite during this period and find evidence of explosive behavior. Our theoretical and simulation results show that such findings can reflect fundamental repricing induced by the AI technology shock; the framework developed in Sections4–5将技术驱动和投机成分分开。separates the technology-driven and speculative components.

5.6.7  讨论5.6.7  Discussion

人工智能时代的结果与互联网公司的调查结果相结合，得出了三个结论。 (1) 两次事件中的技术调整方法在结构上是相同的，但它产生了不对称的结果。在互联网公司的案例中，两项测试都拒绝了：这种调整加剧了约会，但证实了猜测。在人工智能时代，标准测试的拒绝率为10%，而调整后的测试则完全消除了信号。这种分歧解决了识别问题：在技术调整的框架内，人工智能时代价格的爆炸性动态与基本面重新定价一致，而不是投机。 (2) 人工智能的反弹与互联网泡沫不同：(i) 大量的 IT 投资和专利增长； (ii) 价格相对基本面的加速程度不那么极端； (iii) 集中于盈利的现有企业。 (3) 两次事件的对比结果表明了一种实用的监测方案。应用 PSY 的中央银行和监管机构应定期并行应用技术调整程序，以获得对爆炸动力学的更精细的诊断。如果这两项测试都被拒绝，就像在互联网公司的案例中那样，就有强有力的证据表明，投机成分超出了技术驱动的基本面。如果标准测试拒绝了，但技术调整测试却没有拒绝，就像我们人工智能时代的应用一样，那么爆炸性动态可归因于技术驱动的基本面重新定价，而不是投机。这种两次测试协议直接解决了技术快速变革时期出现的识别问题。The AI-era results, combined with the dot-com findings, yield three conclusions. (1) The technology-adjustment methodology is structurally identical across both episodes, yet it produces asymmetric outcomes. In the dot-com case, both tests reject: the adjustment sharpens dating but confirms speculation. In the AI era, the standard test rejects at 10% while the adjusted test eliminates the signal entirely. This divergence addresses the identification problem: within the technology-adjusted framework, the explosive dynamics in the AI-era price are consistent with fundamental repricing rather than speculation. (2) The AI rally differs from dot-com: (i) substantial IT investment and patenting growth; (ii) less extreme price-to-fundamental acceleration; (iii) concentration in profitable incumbents. (3) The contrasting results across the two episodes suggest a practical surveillance protocol. Central banks and regulators applying PSY should routinely apply the technology-adjusted procedure in parallel to obtain a more granular diagnosis of explosive dynamics. If both tests reject, as in the dot-com case, there is strong evidence of a speculative component above and beyond technology-driven fundamentals. If the standard test rejects but the technology-adjusted test does not, as in our AI-era application, the explosive dynamics are attributable to technology-driven fundamental repricing rather than speculation. This two-test protocol directly addresses the identification problem that arises during periods of rapid technological change.

5.8 识别策略的稳健性Robustness of the Identification Strategy

识别策略依赖于技术代理与投机泡沫成分的可分离性。附录The identification strategy rests on the separability of technology proxies from the speculative bubble component. AppendixF报告了评估这一假设的五种补充诊断。首先，格兰杰因果关系检验证实，股票收益并不能预测投机时期的技术指标（reports five complementary diagnostics that assess this assumption. First, Granger causality tests confirm that stock returns do not predict technology proxies during speculative periods (p>0.47p>0.47贯穿始终），直接支持可分离性；非投机时期的双向因果关系与正常时期推动价格的基本面是一致的。其次，使用非技术协变量（消费者情绪、波动率指数、工业生产）的安慰剂测试未能复制泡沫消除效应，证实技术指标捕捉到了特定的基本面内容，而不是一般的宏观变化。第三，七大价格差距的 PCA 揭示了一个主导公因子（方差为 60.0%），在任何线性组合中都没有爆炸性行为，提供了与基本面重新定价而非投机一致的横截面证据。第四，训练窗口稳定性分析表明，AI 时代的非拒绝发现在所有 121 个训练窗口中都成立（throughout), directly supporting separability; bidirectional causality during non-speculative periods is consistent with fundamentals driving prices in normal times. Third, PCA of the Magnificent Seven price gaps reveals a dominant common factor (60.0% of variance) with no explosive behavior in any linear combination, providing cross-sectional evidence consistent with fundamental repricing rather than speculation. 6 结论Conclusion

本文为通用技术采用期间的资产价格开发了一个基本面与投机性分解框架。核心发现是，技术驱动的基本面结构性变化会产生局部爆炸性的价格动态，而标准 PSY 泡沫测试系统地将其错误地归类为投机性，这种错误识别在泡沫问题最紧迫时最为重要。将该框架应用于数字时代的两个书挡事件：2020-2025 年人工智能驱动的反弹和 20 世纪 90 年代末互联网泡沫的崛起，我们得出了截然不同的结论。在技​​术调整框架的条件下，一旦考虑到包括全要素生产率、信息技术投资和专利授权在内的技术基本面，人工智能时代在任何常规显着水平上都不会存在投机行为的证据。相比之下，互联网泡沫事件在一定程度上是投机性的：虽然技术调整消除了早期的虚假信号，但它证实了从 1999 年 12 月到 2000 年 3 月期间真实投机的存在。七大公司的公司层面证据在很大程度上强化了这些总体发现：七家公司中的五家在根据公司特定的基本面进行调整后没有表现出爆炸性行为，尽管特斯拉和苹果保留了可能反映特殊投机动态的残余信号。这些结果支持这样一种观点，即当前的人工智能时代反映了生产力的结构性转变，而不是 90 年代末繁荣的重复。This paper develops a fundamental-versus-speculative decomposition framework for asset prices during general-purpose technology adoption. The central finding is that technology-driven structural change in fundamentals generates locally explosive price dynamics that the standard PSY bubble test systematically misclassifies as speculative, a misidentification that matters most precisely when the bubble question is most pressing. Applying the framework to two bookend episodes of the digital age, the 2020–2025 AI-driven rally and the late-1990s dot-com run-up, we reach sharply different conclusions. Conditional on the technology-adjusted framework, no evidence of speculative behavior remains in the AI era at any conventional significance level once technology fundamentals, including total factor productivity, information technology investment, and patent grants, are accounted for. In contrast, the dot-com episode was partially speculative: while the technology adjustment eliminates an early spurious signal, it confirms the presence of genuine speculation from December 1999 to March 2000. Firm-level evidence from the Magnificent Seven largely reinforces these aggregate findings: five of the seven firms show no explosive behavior after adjusting for firm-specific fundamentals, although Tesla and Apple retain residual signals that may reflect idiosyncratic speculative dynamics. These results support the view that the current AI era reflects a structural shift in productivity rather than a repeat of the late 1990s exuberance.

该框架提出了更广泛的方法论观点：技术转型期间应用的标准泡沫测试可能会出现范式错误，将基本面重新定价与投机过度混淆。气泡检测工具包在很大程度上仍然是统计性的。正如风险管理从静态风险价值 (VaR) 阈值发展到信息丰富的条件 VaR (CVaR) 尾部风险衡量指标以及前瞻性、与市场一致的按市值计价 VaR (MMVaR)The framework makes a broader methodological point: standard bubble tests applied during technological transitions risk a paradigm mistake, confusing fundamental repricing for speculative excess. The toolkit for bubble detection has remained largely statistical. Just as risk management evolved from the static Value-at-Risk (VaR) threshold to the more informative tail-risk measures of Conditional VaR (CVaR) and the forward-looking, market-consistent Mark-to-Market VaR (MMVaR) ofChen et al. (2019)，泡沫检测的计量经济学必须从检测统计爆炸性发展到诊断其经济来源。我们的框架是朝这个方向迈出的一步：技术驱动的基本面结构变化可以产生局部爆炸性的动态，满足泡沫的所有统计特征，而不存在任何投机成分，并且分解恢复正确的测试规模，同时保留对抗真正泡沫的能力。结果在替代冲击形状（三角形、高斯、Beta 和类 Gamma）、估计方法（DOLS、FMOLS 和一阶差分）以及 AI 时代的 121 个替代训练窗口中都具有稳健性。, the econometrics of bubble detection must evolve from detecting statistical explosiveness to diagnosing its economic source. Our framework is a step in that direction: technology-driven structural change in fundamentals can generate locally explosive dynamics that satisfy all the statistical signatures of a bubble without any speculative component being present, and the decomposition restores correct test size while preserving power against genuine bubbles. The results are robust across alternative shock shapes (triangular, Gaussian, Beta, and Gamma-like), estimation methods (DOLS, FMOLS, and first-differencing), and 121 alternative training windows for the AI era.

这些发现表明，中央银行和金融监管机构应采取两项测试监督协议来进行实时泡沫监测。在技​​术快速转型时期，监管机构应同时运行标准和技术调整的 PSY 测试。如果两者都否认没有泡沫，就像互联网泡沫的情况一样，那么就有强有力的证据表明存在投机成分。如果标准测试拒绝了，但调整后的测试却没有拒绝，就像最近的人工智能案例一样，那么爆炸性动态与基本面重新定价更加一致，而不是与投机一致。该协议为政策提供了更细致的诊断，有助于避免可能抑制技术采用和增长的过早干预。These findings suggest a two-test surveillance protocol for central banks and financial regulators conducting real-time bubble monitoring. During periods of rapid technological transition, regulators should run the standard and technology-adjusted PSY tests in parallel. If both reject the null of no bubble, as in the dot-com case, there is strong evidence of a speculative component. If the standard test rejects but the adjusted test does not, as in the recent AI case, the explosive dynamics are more consistent with fundamental repricing than with speculation. This protocol offers a more nuanced diagnostic for policy, helping avoid premature interventions that could stifle technological adoption and growth.

General-purpose technologies affect firms asymmetrically: technology-intensive industries load heavily onδt\delta_{t}而传统行业负载较轻，虚假爆炸机制在资产层面产生的泡沫模式，聚合成while traditional industries load lightly, so the bubble-like pattern that the spurious-explosiveness mechanism generates at the asset level aggregates into a投资组合层面portfolio-level其大小取决于指数中高风险企业的集中度。这一观察结果在经验上很重要，因为 PSY 测试通常应用于行业指数和广泛市场总量，其中横截面集中度直接重要。pattern whose magnitude depends on the concentration of high-exposure firms in the index. This observation is empirically important because PSY tests are commonly applied to sector indices and to the broad market aggregate, where cross-sectional concentration matters directly.

C.1 经过技术调整的公司级测试Technology-Adjusted Firm-Level Tests

哪里whereRevPSi,treal=revtqi,t/(CPIt×cshoqi,t)\text{RevPS}_{i,t}^{\text{real}}=\text{revtq}_{i,t}/(\text{CPI}_{t}\times\text{cshoq}_{i,t})是扣除 CPI 后的每股收益，is CPI-deflated revenue per share andRDPSi,treal=xrdqi,t/(CPIt×cshoqi,t)\text{RDPS}_{i,t}^{\text{real}}=\text{xrdq}_{i,t}/(\text{CPI}_{t}\times\text{cshoq}_{i,t})是扣除 CPI 后的每股研发支出，两者均由 Compustat 季度数据通过最后观察结转 (LOCF) 插值至月度频率构建而成。每股收入反映了已实现的商业化和公司规模，而每股研发支出则代表了公司特定的技术投资。训练窗口为2006-2019年期间，与Section的指数级AI时代分析一致is CPI-deflated R&D expenditure per share, both constructed from quarterly Compustat data interpolated to monthly frequency via last observation carried forward (LOCF). Revenue per share captures realized commercialization and firm scale, while R&D expenditure per share proxies firm-specific technology investment. The training window is the 2006–2019 period, consistent with the index-level AI-era analysis of Section5.6.4，它晚于互联网泡沫，早于人工智能驱动的反弹。至关重要的是，因为七大七的几只股票在 2006 年至 2019 年窗口期内表现出 PSY 检测到的爆炸性事件（图, which postdates the dot-com bubble and predates the AI-driven rally. Crucially, because several Magnificent Seven stocks exhibit PSY-detected explosive episodes within the 2006–2019 window (FigureC.1），我们从训练样本中排除每只股票自己的泡沫月份。这确保了反事实关系完全根据非泡沫观察来估计，符合训练期不应受到投机动态污染的要求。然后我们计算价格差距), we exclude each stock’s own bubble months from its training sample. This ensures that the counterfactual relationship is estimated exclusively from non-bubble observations, consistent with the requirement that the training period should not be contaminated by speculative dynamics. We then compute the price gapg^i,t=pi,t−f^i,t\hat{g}_{i,t}=p_{i,t}-\hat{f}_{i,t}并将 PSY 应用于残差。and apply PSY to the residual.

表TableC.2和图and FigureC.2呈现所有七只股票的技术调整结果。结果与我们的中心论点一致。技术调整后，多数个股的爆发信号大幅减弱。在未经调整的测试中拒绝零值的四只股票中，有三只（MSFT（测试统计数据）present the technology-adjusted results for all seven stocks. The results are consistent with our central thesis. After technology adjustment, the explosive signals weaken substantially for most stocks. Of the four stocks that rejected the null in the unadjusted test, three (MSFT (test statistic=0.605=0.605）、GOOGL（检验统计量), GOOGL (test statistic=0.633=0.633）和 NVDA（检验统计量), and NVDA (test statistic=1.531=1.531)) 技术调整后不再拒绝任何标准显着性水平。值得注意的是，一旦从公司层面的无泡沫训练数据基本面（排除 34 个泡沫月份后保留 168 个月中的 134 个）估计反事实，跨越 2016-2018 年和 2024-2026 年的广泛 NVDA 爆炸性事件基本上消失，只留下 2016-2017 年的小事件。调整后TSLA仍保持高度显着性（检验统计)) no longer reject at any standard significance level after technology adjustment. Notably, the extensive NVDA explosive episodes spanning 2016–2018 and 2024–2026 largely disappear once the counterfactual is estimated from firm-level fundamentals on bubble-free training data (134 of 168 months retained after excluding 34 bubble months), leaving only minor episodes in 2016–2017. TSLA remains highly significant after adjustment (test statistic=4.696=4.696，拒绝率在 1% 的水平），事件集中在 2020-2021 年期间，与电动汽车的欣快感同时发生；其相对较高, rejecting at the 1% level), with episodes concentrated in the 2020–2021 period coinciding with electric-vehicle euphoria; its relatively highR2R^{2}0.898 表明，即使对于特斯拉来说，公司层面的基本面也占据了价格变化的很大一部分，而残留的爆炸性行为似乎是投机性的。 AAPL 在未经调整的测试中没有拒绝，显示出显着的调整测试统计数据（of 0.898 indicates that the firm-level fundamentals capture a substantial share of price variation even for Tesla, and the residual explosive behavior is plausibly speculative. AAPL, which did not reject in the unadjusted test, shows a significant adjusted test statistic (2.3172.317），在 10% 和 5% 水平上拒绝，但在 1% 水平上拒绝（CV), rejecting at the 10% and 5% levels but not at the 1% level (CV=1%2.660{}_{1\%}=2.660），在 2000 年代初到中期检测到事件，这是 2006 年至 2019 年训练窗口之外的时期，反事实推断不太可靠；它的较低), with detected episodes in the early-to-mid 2000s, a period outside the 2006–2019 training window where the counterfactual extrapolates less reliably; its lowerR2R^{2}0.407 表明，二协变量规范较少捕捉到 Apple 的价格动态，这可能是因为 Apple 从一家利基计算机制造商转型为消费电子产品和服务平台，涉及收入和研发增长以外的驱动因素。其余个股（MSFT、AMZN、META、GOOGL）调整后并未出现爆发性事件，其中of 0.407 suggests that the two-covariate specification captures less of Apple’s price dynamics, possibly because Apple’s transformation from a niche computer maker to a consumer electronics and services platform involved drivers beyond revenue and R&D growth. The remaining stocks (MSFT, AMZN, META, GOOGL) show no explosive episodes after adjustment, withR2R^{2}值范围从 0.741 (MSFT) 到 0.961 (AMZN)。这些公司层面的结果与指数层面的发现相似：技术调整消除了价格明显爆炸性的主要来源，而价格从根本上是由人工智能时代技术增长驱动的。values ranging from 0.741 (MSFT) to 0.961 (AMZN). These firm-level results parallel the index-level finding: the technology adjustment removes the dominant source of apparent explosiveness in prices that are fundamentally driven by AI-era technology growth.

这些公司层面的结果强化了总体发现：技术调整测试与标准 PSY 测试一起使用，揭示了七大股票中明显的投机行为是技术驱动的基本面重新定价，这是两种测试都无法单独提供的诊断分解。These firm-level results reinforce the aggregate finding: the technology-adjusted test, used alongside the standard PSY test, reveals that much of the apparent speculative behavior in Magnificent Seven stocks is technology-driven fundamental repricing, a diagnostic decomposition that neither test offers in isolation.

E.6 区分技术与投机：重叠实验Distinguishing Technology from Speculation: An Overlap Experiment

前面的实验表明，当基本面纳入技术驱动的增长时，即使完全不存在投机泡沫，PSY 也会产生虚假拒绝。一个自然的后续问题是，技术调整的 PSY 测试是否能够识别真正的投机泡沫，同时避免技术组件在两者都存在时产生的虚假检测。我们通过受控重叠实验来解决这个问题。The preceding experiments establish that PSY produces spurious rejections when fundamentals incorporate technology-driven growth, even in the complete absence of a speculative bubble. A natural follow-up question is whether the technology-adjusted PSY test identifies a genuine speculative bubble while avoiding the spurious detection generated by the technology component when both are present. We address this question through a controlled overlap experiment.

E.6.1  设计E.6.1  Design

我们构建了一个数据生成过程，其中技术冲击和真正的投机泡沫在时间上重叠：We construct a data-generating process in which a technology shock and a genuine speculative bubble overlap in time:

  • •

The technology-adjusted price removes both the present-value term𝒯t\mathcal{T}_{t}以及累计技术对股息的贡献：and the cumulative technology contribution to dividends:ptadj=pt−𝒯t−∑s=1tδsp_{t}^{\mathrm{adj}}=p_{t}-\mathcal{T}_{t}-\sum_{s=1}^{t}\delta_{s}。我们将 PSY 应用于去趋势的对数价格，这是我们的实证分析中使用的变换。. 关键的预测是，未经调整的 PSY 测试应该首先在纯技术阶段（介于The key prediction is that the unadjusted PSY test should first trigger during the technology-only phase (betweent=50t=50，技术窗口的开始，以及, the start of technology window, andt=100t=100，气泡窗口的开始），构成虚假的早期检测，而技术调整的 PSY 测试应在气泡窗口期间或之后首先触发（真正的检测）。, the start of bubble window), constituting a spurious early detection, while the technology-adjusted PSY test should first trigger during or after the bubble window (a genuine detection).

The technology-adjusted test correctly restricts its first detection to the bubble window, with a first detection date 125 periods later than the unadjusted test.

该实验说明了在气泡检测中忽视技术驱动的基本原理的实际后果。未经调整的 PSY 测试会在任何投机活动开始前 41 个周期产生虚假预警，第一次检测发生在纯技术阶段（This experiment illustrates the practical consequences of ignoring technology-driven fundamentals in bubble detection. The unadjusted PSY test produces a spurious early warning 41 periods before any speculative activity begins, with the first detection occurring during the technology-only phase (t=59∈[50,100]t=59\in[50,100]）。相比之下，经过技术调整的测试避免了误报，并以从开始起大约 84 个周期的检测延迟来识别真正的气泡，在 PSY 应用中对真正爆炸过程通常观察到的检测延迟范围内。重叠设计的信息量特别大：因为技术和气泡窗口共享 50 个周期的重叠（). In contrast, the technology-adjusted test avoids the false alarm and identifies the genuine bubble with a detection lag of approximately 84 periods from its onset, within the range of detection delays typically observed in PSY applications to genuine explosive processes. The overlap design is particularly informative: because the technology and bubble windows share a 50-period overlap ([100,150][100,150]），未经调整的测试无法区分爆炸动力学的来源，而调整后的测试只能识别推测成分。), the unadjusted test cannot distinguish the source of the explosive dynamics, while the adjusted test identifies only the speculative component.

本附录报告了五种补充诊断方法，用于评估技术代理与投机泡沫成分的可分离性，这是本文的主要识别假设。而命题This appendix reports five complementary diagnostics that assess the separability of technology proxies from the speculative bubble component, which is the paper’s main identification assumption. While Proposition2为这种可分离性提供了结构上的理由，下面的测试评估了其经验有效性。provides a structural justification for this separability, the tests below evaluate its empirical validity.

F.1 格兰杰因果检验Granger Causality Tests

在可分离性假设下，股票收益不应在投机时期出现格兰杰原因的技术代理：如果泡沫成分Under the separability assumption, stock returns should not Granger-cause the technology proxies during speculative periods: if the bubble componentbtb_{t}与基本面正交，爆炸性的价格动态不应反馈到实际的技术变量中。然而，在非投机时期，预计技术与回报之间存在双向因果关系，因为技术基本面驱动价格，而股市估值影响企业投资。is orthogonal to fundamentals, explosive price dynamics should not feed back into real technology variables. During non-speculative periods, however, bidirectional causality between technology and returns is expected, since technology fundamentals drive prices and stock market valuations affect corporate investment.

Lag lengths are selected by the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC). F.2 安慰剂测试：非技术协变量Placebo Tests: Non-Technology Covariates

如果技术调整测试消除了爆炸性信号，特别是因为技术代理捕获了真正的基本面，那么用经济上不相关的协变量替换这些代理应该无法消除信号。我们通过 DOLS 在相同的训练窗口上对三个非技术变量（消费者情绪（密歇根大学指数）、VIX 隐含波动率指数和工业生产 (INDPRO)）的纳斯达克价格进行回归来构建“安慰剂”反事实，然后将 PSY 应用于由此产生的价格差距。表If the technology-adjusted test eliminates explosive signals specifically because the technology proxies capture genuine fundamentals, then replacing these proxies with economically irrelevant covariates should fail to eliminate the signal. We construct “placebo” counterfactuals by regressing log NASDAQ prices on three non-technology variables (consumer sentiment (University of Michigan Index), the VIX implied volatility index, and industrial production (INDPRO)) via DOLS over the same training windows, then apply PSY to the resulting price gaps. TableF.2将结果与技术基线一起报告。reports the results alongside the technology baseline.

对于人工智能时代，所有三种安慰剂产生的 GSADF 统计数据远低于各自的 10% 临界值（For the AI era, all three placebos yield GSADF statistics well below their respective 10 percent critical values (−0.223-0.223, 0.7120.712, 和, and0.8690.869反对againstCV0.10=1.334\text{CV}_{0.10}=1.334），与基线技术调整一致（检验统计量), consistent with the baseline technology adjustment (test statistic=−0.275=-0.275）。这是预期的：当数据中不存在爆炸性动态时，正确或不正确的协变量都不会产生拒绝。). This is expected: when no explosive dynamic exists in the data, neither the correct nor incorrect covariates will produce a rejection.

互联网公司的结果更加微妙。工业生产不排斥（The dot-com results are more nuanced. Industrial production does not reject (test statistic=1.460<CV0.10=1.768\text{test statistic}=1.460<\text{CV}_{0.10}=1.768; R2=0.743R^{2}=0.743），证实通用宏观经济变量无法复制技术调整的泡沫消除效应。 VIX 无法在互联网时代进行测试，因为 CBOE VIX 系列始于 1990 年 1 月，仅提供 12 个训练观测值，不足以进行可靠的 DOLS 估计。然而，消费者信心在 10% 和 5% 的水平上都拒绝接受（), confirming that a generic macroeconomic variable cannot replicate the technology adjustment’s bubble-elimination effect. The VIX could not be tested for the dot-com era because the CBOE VIX series begins in January 1990, providing only 12 training observations, which is insufficient for reliable DOLS estimation. However, consumer sentiment rejects at both the 10 and 5 percent levels (test statistic=2.283\text{test statistic}=2.283, CV0.10=1.768\text{CV}_{0.10}=1.768, CV0.05=2.025\text{CV}_{0.05}=2.025）。结果需要仔细解释。基于情感的 DOLS 规范实现了较低的). The result requires careful interpretation. The sentiment-based DOLS specification achieves a lowR2R^{2}仅 0.308，表明情绪不能很好地预测原木价格水平；由此产生的价格差距保留了大部分原始价格变化，包括基本面和投机成分。此外，在互联网泡沫时期，消费者信心本身就受到科技驱动的股市上涨通过财富效应的严重影响of only 0.308, indicating that sentiment is a poor predictor of log price levels; the resulting price gap retains most of the original price variation, including both the fundamental and speculative components. Moreover, during the dot-com boom, consumer sentiment was itself heavily influenced by the technology-driven equity rally through wealth effects(Shiller, 2015)，使其成为其旨在“安慰剂”对抗的动态的内生因素。因此，情感拒绝不会破坏识别策略；它反映了这样一个事实，即情绪对于泡沫来说并不是外生的。, making it endogenous to the very dynamics it is intended to “placebo” against. The sentiment rejection therefore does not undermine the identification strategy; it reflects the fact that sentiment is not exogenous to the bubble.

F.4 训练-窗口稳定性分析Training-Window Stability Analysis

技术调整测试的一个潜在问题是结果取决于用于估计 DOLS 系数的训练周期。我们系统地改变培训窗口结束日期：对于.com应用程序，从1985年1月到1994年12月（固定开始日期为1975年1月）；对于AI应用程序，从2010年1月到2019年12月（固定开始日期为2006年1月）。我们重新估计每个子样本的 DOLS 系数，并将 PSY 应用于由此产生的价格差距。表A potential concern with the technology-adjusted test is that results depend on the training period used to estimate the DOLS coefficients. We systematically vary the training window end-date: from January 1985 to December 1994 for the dot-com application (with a fixed start of January 1975) and from January 2010 to December 2019 for the AI application (with a fixed start of January 2006). We reestimate the DOLS coefficients on each subsample and apply PSY to the resulting price gaps. TableF.4报告代表窗口；图reports representative windows; FigureF.2显示完整的轨迹。displays the complete trajectories.

这两个时代呈现出鲜明的对比。对于人工智能时代，GSADF 统计范围为The two eras present a clear contrast. For the AI era, the GSADF statistic ranges from−0.30-0.30 to 0.840.84在 121 个训练窗口中，从未接近 10% 的临界值 1.176。 “没有人工智能泡沫”的结论对训练窗口的选择完全不敏感。尽管 DOLS 系数存在很大差异，但这种稳健性仍然存在：IT 投资系数across 121 training windows, never approaching the 10 percent critical value of 1.176. The “no AI bubble” conclusion is entirely insensitive to training window choice. This robustness holds despite substantial variation in the DOLS coefficients: the IT-investment coefficientβ^IT\hat{\beta}_{\text{IT}}范围为0.35至2.65，专利系数ranges from 0.35 to 2.65, and the patent coefficientβ^Pat\hat{\beta}_{\text{Pat}}跨度spans−0.16-0.16到 1.19，但调整后的价格差距从未产生拒绝。的to 1.19, yet the adjusted price gap never produces a rejection. TheR2R^{2}自始至终都保持在较高水平（0.82-0.91），这表明无论具体的训练窗口如何，技术代理都能解释价格变化的大部分且稳定的份额。remains high throughout (0.82–0.91), indicating that the technology proxies explain a large and stable share of price variation regardless of the specific training window.

对于互联网时代，情况更加复杂。测试统计量的变化范围约为 1.30（训练于 1987 年 9 月结束）到 2.76（训练于 1985 年 6 月结束），范围为 1.46。 10% 的临界值为 1.745，早期训练窗口（在 1987 年中期之前结束）会产生拒绝，从大约 1987 年中期到 1988 年末的差距会产生不拒绝，然后从 1988 年末到 1992 年初结束的窗口会返回到拒绝，然后稳定在 1992 年中期之后结束的窗口的临界值以下。这种不稳定的根源主要是专利系数，该系数的变化范围为For the dot-com era, the picture is more complex. The test statistic varies from approximately 1.30 (training ending September 1987) to 2.76 (training ending June 1985), a range of 1.46. With the 10 percent critical value at 1.745, early training windows (ending before mid-1987) yield rejections, a gap from approximately mid-1987 through late 1988 yields non-rejections, then windows ending from late 1988 through early 1992 return to rejection, before settling below the critical value for windows ending after mid-1992. The source of this instability is primarily the patent coefficient, which varies from−0.39-0.39（1985 年 1 月）至(January 1985) to+1.04+1.04(1994 年 12 月)，而 IT 系数相对稳定在(December 1994), while the IT coefficient is comparatively stable at0.420.42–0.490.49。这种敏感性反映了专利在技术与增长关系中不断变化的角色：在 20 世纪 80 年代初，专利授权并不能很好地体现创新. This sensitivity reflects the changing role of patenting in the technology-growth relationship: in the early 1980s, patent grants were a poor proxy for innovation(Kogan et al., 2017)，而它们的信息内容在 20 世纪 90 年代有了显着改善。, while their informational content improved substantially through the 1990s.

F.5 Hansen (1992) 参数不稳定测试Hansen (1992) Parameter Instability Test

训练窗口分析揭示了系数变化，但没有正式测试协整关系在每个训练周期内是否稳定。我们应用The training-window analysis reveals coefficient variation, but does not formally test whether the cointegrating relationship is stable within each training period. We apply theHansen (1992) LcL_{c}检验协整回归中的参数不稳定性，它检验 DOLS 系数对于鞅参数过程的替代方案是恒定的原假设。表test for parameter instability in cointegrating regressions, which tests the null hypothesis that the DOLS coefficients are constant against the alternative of a martingale parameter process. TableF.5报告结果。reports the results.

的TheLcL_{c}测试拒绝了两个时代和两个规范中的参数稳定性。对于.com基线（仅限技术），test rejects parameter stability in both eras and both specifications. For the dot-com baseline (technology-only),Lc=1.845L_{c}=1.845 (p=0.009p=0.009）；对于人工智能时代的基线，); for the AI-era baseline,Lc=3.994L_{c}=3.994 (p<0.001p<0.001）。包括术语利差在内的扩展规范得出了类似的结论（). The extended specifications including the term spread yield similar conclusions (Lc=1.780L_{c}=1.780, p=0.018p=0.018对于.com；for dot-com;Lc=3.941L_{c}=3.941, p<0.001p<0.001面向人工智能时代）。所有统计数据都远远超过 1% 临界值（基线为 1.160，扩展为 1.278），这表明参数不稳定的有力证据。for the AI era). All statistics far exceed the 1% critical values (1.160 for baseline, 1.278 for extended), indicating strong evidence of parameter instability.

这一发现具有重要意义。原木价格和技术代理之间的协整关系在训练期间并不稳定。对于互联网时代（1975-1990）来说，这并不奇怪：随着 IT 从大型机过渡到个人计算机再到网络系统，技术增长关系发生了巨大的演变。对于人工智能时代（2006-2019），不稳定性反映了从移动和云计算到新生人工智能范式的转变，专利系数（捕获创新成分）吸收了大部分结构变化，如第 1 节的训练窗口分析所示。This finding has important implications. The cointegrating relationship between log prices and technology proxies is not stable over the training periods. For the dot-com era (1975–1990), this is unsurprising: the technology-growth nexus evolved dramatically as IT transitioned from mainframes to personal computers to networked systems. For the AI era (2006–2019), instability reflects the transition from mobile and cloud computing to the nascent AI paradigm, with the patent coefficient (capturing innovation composition) absorbing most of the structural change, as the training-window analysis of SectionF.4确认。confirms.

汉森的拒绝并没有使技术调整测试无效，但它限定了解释。 DOLS 估计代表了训练期间的平均技术价格关系，只要该平均值捕获了典型的均衡，调整就是有效的。训练窗口分析提供了保证：尽管参数不稳定，但定性结论是稳健的。特别是，即使各个系数差异很大，人工智能时代的非拒绝发现在所有 121 个训练窗口中都成立。尽管大多数规范都支持定性解释（1999-2000 年的真正推测性峰值），但网络公司的结果更加脆弱，随着训练窗口的变化，GSADF 统计数据会跨越临界值。未来的工作可以通过时变系数方法更正式地解决参数不稳定性问题，例如The Hansen rejection does not invalidate the technology-adjusted test, but it qualifies the interpretation. The DOLS estimates represent an average technology-price relationship over the training period, and the adjustment is valid insofar as this average captures the typical equilibrium. The training-window analysis provides reassurance: despite parameter instability, the qualitative conclusions are robust. In particular, the AI-era non-rejection finding holds across all 121 training windows, even as individual coefficients vary substantially. The dot-com results are more fragile, with the GSADF statistic crossing the critical value as the training window shifts, though the qualitative interpretation (a genuine speculative peak in 1999–2000) is supported across the majority of specifications. Future work could address parameter instability more formally through time-varying coefficient approaches, such as theBierens and Martins (2010)时变协整框架或具有卡尔曼滤波参数的状态空间模型。time-varying cointegration framework or state-space models with Kalman-filtered parameters.
